visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Compare with is None and Drop the Empty else
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The code compares with == None and has an else branch that assigns the variable to itself. Use is None and remove the else. The output must stay the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
def add_item(item, items=None):
    if items == None:
        items = []
    else:
        items = items
    items.append(item)
    return items


first = add_item("a")
second = add_item("b", first)
print(first)
print(second)

solution.code:
def add_item(item, items=None):
    if items is None:
        items = []
    items.append(item)
    return items


first = add_item("a")
second = add_item("b", first)
print(first)
print(second)
solution.explanation: None is a single object, so is None is the exact and fastest test (== can be overridden by a class), and an else branch that does nothing only adds noise.
